prompt: Acidic ring-opening of 2-methyl-1,2-epoxypropane (methyl-substituted epoxide) with H2O / H2SO4. Draw the diol product.

answers.label: 2-methyl-1,2-propanediol (water attacked the 3° C under acid conditions)

traps.note: Under acid, attack goes to the MORE substituted C (carbocation-like character); under base, to the LESS substituted.

explanation: Protonated epoxide develops cation character at the more substituted (3°) carbon. H2O attacks there in a cation-like SN1 fashion. The result: OH on the originally-substituted carbon = tertiary alcohol end + primary alcohol end.
